Walk Surface / Collision Builder
Manual pieces are gameplay collision helpers. Terrain patches are visual/walk-surface helpers. Keep blockers here; sculpt/look-dev patches in Terrain Builder.
1 AddBlock, floor, or ramp
2 ShapeMove, rotate, scale
3 SaveSave manual pieces
4 MatchSelect same asset
5 ApplyCopy to matches
Terrain Tools
Terrain patches are editable ground helpers for roots, hills, paths, and footstep surface painting. They are not red blockers.
Selected Surface: none
Brush sculpts the selected terrain stamp/patch. Hover over selected terrain, then click or drag to raise/lower the walkable mesh.
Surface types affect footstep sounds only and use helper colors.
Terrain Stamps
Terrain stamps create real low-poly walkable mesh pieces. Select one, then tune width, length, height, softness, and side heights below.
⌁Root MoundRaised uneven root/ground bump for trees and roots.
◎Round Root MoundCircular raised root/ground bump for trees and radial roots.
▴HillSmooth raised walkable hill.
╱SlopeAngled walkable ramp for elevation changes.
▰Stair RampStepped walkable ramp.
═Path SegmentFlat path piece for roads/trails.
Control heights shape mound/hill stamps. Slope/stair/cliff/path use the same values where useful.

Layer controls are editor-only. Hide/lock does not change saved layout data.

Quest Editor
Creates local quest drafts for this village. Existing Hub tutorial quests stay safe.
Quest Builder V1
Builds local quest configs that can point to movable Quest Target Markers, badges, and Journal entries.
Select a quest to edit.
Quest Targets / Markers
Movable guidance targets for active quests. In player mode only the current active quest marker is shown.
Interaction Zones
Interaction zones are invisible trigger areas. Use them to mark story spots, quest targets, audio/weather areas, store/dojo entrances, or future cutscene triggers.
Interiors
Step 1: Create Interior Step 2: Create Door Step 3: Assign Interior To Door
Add Interior: upload one room GLB, optional MP3 music, name it, describe it, then save.
GLB: no file selected
MP3: no file selected
Interior lighting is editable per room: dim it, brighten it, or shift the color without adding heavy real lights.
Interior isolation hides outside village visuals while inside rooms.
Interior Isolation: Inactive
Player Floor Offset: 0.00
Doors
Add Door starts placement mode. Click the ground to place the door zone, then the move gizmo appears. The door is a trigger zone; the selected interior GLB loads when the player enters.
Interior Assets
Interior fake lights are cheap visual glow props. They are not real lights, so they are safe to use in rooms.
1: Enter interior 2: Move exit door 3: Add fake lanterns/glows 4: Cache or hard save layout
Displays
Displays are interior links: arcade cabinets, YouTube screens, books, products, and future quest hooks.
Interior Hotspots / Interior Links
Place lightweight link hotspots inside the active room. They save per interior and do not snap to the ground.
Interior Video Screens
Upload an MP4 and optional poster image. Keep videos short and compressed; poster images are the safe fallback when autoplay is blocked. Free compressor: FreeConvert Video Compressor
1: Upload MP4 2: Optional poster 3: Add Video Screen 4: Move it 5: Save
MP4: no file selected
Poster: no file selected
Interior NFT Frames
Add an NFT collection by contract, then place frame slots over the room’s wall frames. Frame 1 uses NFT 1, Frame 2 uses NFT 2, unless you enter a Token ID.
1: Enter interior 2: Add collection contract 3: Add NFT Frame Slot 4: Move/resize/rotate it 5: Optional Token ID override 6: Save
Collection manifest: none loaded
Collectibles
Floating collectibles are visual-only progression pickups. They save per village and collected state stays local for V1.
Collectibles: --
Badge Builder
To add a new badge image, upload it manually to /assets/badges/, then paste the path here.
Requirement guide: Common 10-50, Uncommon 50-150, Rare 150-500, Epic 500-1500, Legendary 1500-5000, Mythic secret or very high.
Badge List Click any active badge below to load it into the editor.
Loading badges...
Click or drop PNG/WebP badge image for local preview
For permanent badge images, upload PNG/WebP to /assets/badges/ in GitHub, then paste the path here. Drag/drop is local preview/testing only. Use square 512x512 images when possible, 1024x1024 max, transparent background preferred, under 500KB if possible.
Upload Badge Image Permanently
Permanent upload saves to /assets/badges/ using a safe badgeId filename. PNG/WebP preferred, square 512x512 preferred, 1024x1024 max, transparent background preferred, under 500KB if possible.
PreviewSelect a badge.
Archived Badges
Archived badges stay editable later, but do not appear in the Journal, count toward progression, or unlock.

Welcome

Hub Village

Hub Village is the living center of the Rebel Ants Universe. Talk to NPCs, follow Hub Journey quests, collect floating items, open chests, enter dojos and interiors, inspect NFT frames, use arcade/store/video links, open your Journal, travel through portals, and watch weather and time change the village. For your first quest, look for the glowing marker above the Hub Guide.
